description: This file defines the 'Smarty_Template_Cached' class, which manages cached template data within the Smarty templating engine, including cache validation, rendering, and lock management.

classes.name: Smarty_Template_Cached
classes.description: Class responsible for managing cached template data in Smarty, handling cache validation, rendering, and locking mechanisms.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache object with template details and loads the appropriate cache resource handler.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Static method to create a cached template object and populate it with cache data.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the cached template, handling debugging and cache processing.

methods.name: isCached
methods.description: Checks if the cache is valid, considering expiration, compile checks, and lock status.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Processes the cache with the handler, marking it as valid or invalid.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Reads cached content from the handler, unless recompiled is required.
